name: Spinach & Cheddar Scramble
description: Fluffy scrambled eggs folded with tender baby spinach and melted cheddar.

steps.instruction: Whisk 4 eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Whisk vigorously for 30 seconds to incorporate air for fluffier eggs.

steps.instruction: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and add 1 cup of spinach until wilted.
steps.tip: Spinach wilts very quickly — about 60 seconds is all it takes.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Turn down the stove and stir the wilted spinach.

steps.instruction: Pour in whisked eggs and cook gently for 3 minutes, stirring slowly to form soft curds.
steps.tip: Keep heat on medium-low so the eggs stay creamy and tender.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Turn off the stove now and gently stir the curds so they don't overcook!

steps.instruction: Sprinkle 2 oz shredded cheddar over the top, turn off the heat, and let it melt.
steps.tip: The residual skillet heat will melt the cheese perfectly in 30 seconds.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! The cheese is melted. Turn off the stove and plate your eggs!

name: Classic French Omelet
description: Tender, buttery golden omelet stuffed with melted sharp cheddar.

steps.instruction: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl and whisk thoroughly until completely smooth.
steps.tip: No white streaks should remain for a uniform French texture.

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat until foamy, then pour in the eggs.
steps.tip: Swirl the pan constantly for the first 45 seconds to create small curds.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Stop swirling, curds are set. Turn down the stove and add cheese!

steps.instruction: Spread cheddar down the center, cook for 2 minutes, then fold one edge over.
steps.tip: Tilt the pan to easily roll the omelet onto your plate.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Slide the omelet onto your plate right now while it's soft and glossy!

name: Simple Chicken & Rice Bowl
description: Pan-seared seasoned chicken breast served over fluffy warm rice.

steps.instruction: Dice chicken breast into bite-sized 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Cutting into uniform bite-sized cubes ensures fast, even searing.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over high heat, then sear chicken cubes for 6 minutes.
steps.tip: Don't move the chicken for the first 2 minutes so it develops a nice golden crust.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Check that chicken is golden brown and cooked through (165°F)!

steps.instruction: Spoon chicken over warm cooked rice and top with cheese if desired.
steps.tip: Drizzle any leftover pan juices over the rice for maximum flavor.

name: Grandma's Quick Chili
description: Hearty, warming beef chili loaded with black beans, simmered tomatoes, and savory spices.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a deep pot over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and brown for 5 minutes.
steps.tip: Break up the meat with a wooden spoon as it browns.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Drain excess fat if needed, then prepare your canned ingredients.

steps.instruction: Pour in 1 can drained black beans and 1 can crushed tomatoes. Stir to combine.
steps.tip: Add a teaspoon of chili powder and cumin if you have them in your spice rack.

steps.instruction: Reduce heat to low, cover with lid, and simmer gently for 12 minutes.
steps.tip: Simmering lets the beans soak in the rich tomato beef broth.
steps.timer_alert: Ding! Chili is fully simmered and rich! Turn off the stove and ladle into bowls.

steps.instruction: Ladle into warm bowls and top with shredded cheddar.
steps.tip: Chili tastes even better as leftovers tomorrow!

name: Cheesy Rice & Beans
description: Creamy, satisfying skillet combining black beans, warm rice, and bubbling melted cheddar.

steps.instruction: Rinse and drain 1 can of black beans.
steps.tip: Rinsing removes excess sodium and starch.

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat, add rice and beans, and heat through for 4 minutes.
steps.tip: Stir frequently so the rice doesn't stick to the bottom.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! The rice and beans are piping hot. Stir in the cheese!

steps.instruction: Stir in shredded cheddar until completely melted and creamy (about 1 minute).
steps.tip: Turn off heat before stirring so the cheese doesn't separate.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Turn off the stove and give the cheese a creamy final stir!

name: Pan-Seared Golden Chicken
description: Juicy pan-seared chicken cutlets with a crispy golden olive oil crust.

steps.instruction: Slice chicken breast horizontally into thin cutlets and season both sides.
steps.tip: Thin cutlets cook twice as fast and stay much juicier.

steps.instruction: Heat skillet with olive oil over medium-high heat. Sear chicken 4 minutes on the first side.
steps.tip: Leave untouched until it releases easily from the skillet.
steps.timer_alert: Time to flip! Turn the chicken cutlets over to the second side.

steps.instruction: Flip and sear the other side for 3 minutes until cooked through.
steps.tip: Toss in fresh spinach during the last minute to wilt right in the pan juices.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Remove chicken from heat and let it rest for 2 minutes before slicing.

name: Creamy Spinach Scrambled Eggs
description: Velvety scrambled eggs enriched with a splash of milk and sautéed spinach.

steps.instruction: Whisk 4 eggs together with 1/4 cup whole milk and a pinch of salt.
steps.tip: Milk creates steam pockets inside the eggs, making them silky and light.

steps.instruction: Sauté spinach in melted butter for 1 minute until wilted.
steps.tip: Spread the wilted spinach evenly across the skillet floor.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Stir the wilted spinach and pour in the whisked eggs.

steps.instruction: Pour in egg-milk mixture and cook on low heat for 3 minutes with gentle sweeps.
steps.tip: Low heat is the secret to custard-like eggs.
steps.timer_alert: Ding! Eggs are creamy and set. Pull them off the heat right now!

name: Quick Beef & Rice Skillet
description: Sautéed ground beef tossed with warm rice, crushed tomatoes, and melted cheese.

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
steps.tip: Drain any excess rendered fat from the skillet.
steps.timer_alert: Beef is browned! Now add in the rice and crushed tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Add cooked rice and crushed tomatoes. Stir and heat through for 4 minutes.
steps.tip: Let the rice absorb the savory tomato beef juices.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Top with cheddar cheese and remove from heat.

name: 15-Minute Black Bean Soup
description: Thick, warm black bean soup simmered with sweet crushed tomatoes and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Warm olive oil in a pot, add black beans (undrained) and crushed tomatoes.
steps.tip: Using the bean liquid provides natural thickness and body.

steps.instruction: Simmer gently on medium-low for 8 minutes, mashing roughly half the beans.
steps.tip: Mashing some beans creates a luscious, hearty texture.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Turn off the stove. Your black bean soup is thick and ready to serve!

name: Ultimate High-Protein Scramble
description: Power-packed scramble with 3 whole eggs, shredded seared chicken, and tender baby spinach.

steps.instruction: Warm shredded or diced pre-cooked chicken in melted butter for 2 minutes.
steps.tip: Using leftover or pre-cooked chicken makes this ready in under 10 minutes.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Stir the chicken cutlets and add the spinach to wilt.

steps.instruction: Add spinach until wilted, then pour in 3 whisked eggs.
steps.tip: Stir continuously on low heat for creamy curds.
steps.timer_alert: Time's up! Take it off the heat immediately for fluffy, protein-packed eggs.
